race.comment: BOLD JESTER (2) drifted well back last start before winding up strongly to finish second over 1200m at Murtoa, making it three consecutive minor placings. At his top now and is the one to beat with Egan taking back over. GALAGACISCO (4) is knocking on the door. Expect Spain to bounce straight to the front from the inside alley and give a great sight. Can steal it if left alone through the middle stages. SCORCHING BEAUTY (12) is lightly raced and still improving. Keep safe. DEADLY DEVIL (3) best of the rest.
